supplements.title: Ginkgolic acid targets HSPA8 to trigger ferroptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma via chaperone-mediated autophagy-dependent GPX4 degradation.
supplements.summary: Ginkgolic acid from Ginkgo biloba kills liver cancer cells by triggering a specific type of cell death called ferroptosis.

supplements.title: Polyphyllin II regulates ROS levels and promotes ferroptosis in bladder cancer cells.
supplements.summary: Polyphyllin II kills bladder cancer cells by triggering ferroptosis through increased reactive oxygen species and reduced antioxidant protein activity.

supplements.title: Acute and chronic exercise-conditioned serum effects on cancer cells in vitro: a systematic review.
supplements.summary: Acute exercise-conditioned serum inhibits growth of multiple cancer cell types in vitro, but chronic effects remain inconsistent.

supplements.title: Modulation of NF-κB and oxidative stress pathways in ethanol-induced gastric injury by a multi-component herbal formula: An in vivo study.
supplements.summary: A herbal formula reduced stomach damage from chronic alcohol use by lowering inflammation and oxidative stress in animal studies.

supplements.title: Metabolomics, network pharmacology, and molecular docking guided discrimination of constituents in four varieties of luohan guo (Siraitia grosvenorii): an assessment of core active ingredients and their potential antioxidant mechanisms.
supplements.summary: Study identifies key antioxidant compounds in different luohan guo varieties and explains how they protect cells from damage.

supplements.title: Impact of pectin addition on acrylamide formation in bakery products: mitigation strategies.
supplements.summary: Adding pectin to bakery products like doughnuts and muffins reduces acrylamide, a potential carcinogen found in baked goods.

supplements.title: Safety-relevant contaminants and nutritional quality of hazelnut skin and pumpkin seed proteins.
supplements.summary: Hazelnut skin and pumpkin seed proteins offer safe, nutritious alternatives to soy and pea proteins for food production.

supplements.title: Inhibitory effect of Vaccinium arctostaphylos L. and Vaccinium myrtillus L. extracts on melanogenesis in α-MSH-induced B16F10 melanoma cells: in vitro, molecular docking ADMET and drug-likeness studies.
supplements.summary: Vaccinium berry extracts inhibit melanin production in melanoma cells, suggesting potential as treatments for hyperpigmentation and skin conditions.

supplements.title: Comparative liquid chromatography-electrospray ionization-tandem mass spectrometry profiling and bioactivity evaluation of Ebenus macrophylla Jaub. & Spach leaf, stalk and root extracts: an in vitro and in silico approach.
supplements.summary: Turkish plant extracts showed antioxidant and antiproliferative properties in laboratory tests, with potential cancer-fighting applications.

supplements.title: Targeting systemic and tumor metabolic balances with ketogenic diets enhance efficacy of therapy in FLT3-ITD acute myeloid leukemia.
supplements.summary: A ketogenic diet doubled the effectiveness of FLT3 inhibitors in treating FLT3-mutated acute myeloid leukemia by altering cancer cell metabolism.

supplements.title: Sexual dimorphism shapes renal metabolic adaptation to a ketogenic diet.
supplements.summary: Female kidneys uniquely activate ketone and glucose production on ketogenic diets, revealing sex differences critical for understanding diet's health effects.

supplements.title: HSP90 inhibition potentiates oxidant-based antimelanoma action of novel thioquercetin derivatives by compromising AhR/CYP1A1 pathway.
supplements.summary: New quercetin derivatives combined with HSP90 inhibitors kill melanoma cells by increasing oxidative stress and blocking detoxification pathways.

supplements.title: The logarithmic phase as a therapeutic direction: evaluating pharmacological strategies against cancer progression.
supplements.summary: Targeting cancer's rapid growth phase with combination therapies and natural compounds offers precision treatment to overcome drug resistance and improve survival.

supplements.title: Reply to: Letter to the editor: Exercise, biomarkers, and cancer: considering the nuances in study design and interpretation.
supplements.summary: Supervised aerobic exercise during chemotherapy may help regulate biomarkers in cancer patients, though larger standardized studies are needed.

supplements.title: Ginsenoside compound K targets DUSP5 to inhibit the malignant progression of glioblastoma via the ERK pathway.
supplements.summary: Ginsenoside compound K slows glioblastoma growth by activating a protein that reduces cancer cell proliferation and extends survival in mice.

off_label.title: Small-molecule CBLB inhibitor abolishes EGFR ubiquitination, reduces receptor endocytosis, and diminishes cell motility signaling.
off_label.summary: A new drug blocks EGFR ubiquitination and reduces cancer cell movement in oral squamous cell carcinoma by preventing receptor internalization.

off_label.title: NEK8 kinase-mediated lactate increase impairs antitumor immunity decreasing radiotherapy sensitivity in colorectal cancer.
off_label.summary: NEK8 kinase promotes colorectal cancer radioresistance by increasing lactate, which suppresses immune T cells; blocking NEK8 restores immunity and improves radiotherapy.

off_label.title: Dinaciclib reduces MCL-1 levels and triggers apoptosis in adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma.
off_label.summary: Dinaciclib kills adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma cells by lowering MCL-1 protein levels and triggering programmed cell death.

off_label.title: Lactate-mediated NK cell dysfunction as a prognostic marker and therapeutic target in breast cancer.
off_label.summary: High lactate in breast tumors suppresses natural killer cells; blocking lactate restores immune cell function and tumor killing in breast cancer.

off_label.title: Pharmacologic targeting of the dopamine D2 receptor impacts the efficacy of immune checkpoint blockade in melanoma.
off_label.summary: Blocking dopamine D2 receptors with FDA-approved drugs may enhance immune checkpoint inhibitor effectiveness in treating melanoma.

off_label.title: Multifactorial Intervention of Primary Prevention in High Risk Subjects: a Randomized Trial
off_label.summary: A combination of smoking cessation, low-dose aspirin, diet changes, and CT screening may reduce cancer risk in heavy smokers.

off_label.title: Burosumab treatment in an adult with FGF23-mediated hypophosphatemia due to cutaneous skeletal hypophosphatemia syndrome.
off_label.summary: Burosumab successfully treated an adult with rare cutaneous skeletal hypophosphatemia syndrome by targeting FGF23 protein instead of requiring multiple daily medications.

off_label.title: Malignant transformation in patients with monoclonal gammopathy of undetermined significance treated with teriparatide for osteoporosis: a bicenter retrospective study and analysis of the French national pharmacovigilance database.
off_label.summary: Teriparatide appears safe for osteoporosis patients with precancerous blood cell changes, with minimal cancer progression observed.

off_label.title: Research progress on chronic stress stimulation and gastric cancer metastasis.
off_label.summary: Chronic psychological stress promotes gastric cancer spread through stress hormones that activate cancer cells and suppress immune defenses.

off_label.title: [Cancer-related neuropsychiatric disorders].
off_label.summary: Cancer impairs cognitive function through brain inflammation and aging, treatable with exercise, therapy, and mindfulness.

off_label.title: Single-cell profiling of HDAC inhibitor-induced EBV lytic heterogeneity defines abortive and refractory states in B lymphoblasts.
off_label.summary: HDAC inhibitors trigger EBV reactivation in lymphomas, but only some cells succeed; NF-κB and CD137 signaling block full viral activation.

off_label.title: HNF4α-HKDC1 axis orchestrates a metabolic rewiring to promote migration and metastasis in advanced gastric cancer.
off_label.summary: Researchers identified that blocking the HNF4α-HKDC1 pathway in gastric cancer reduces cancer spread and metastasis.

off_label.title: Association of statin use with pathological complete response in postmenopausal patients with hormone receptor-positive breast cancer.
off_label.summary: Statins may improve chemotherapy response in postmenopausal women with hormone receptor-positive breast cancer, though findings are preliminary and require confirmation.

off_label.title: Broad-acting antivirals: the pursuit of pan-viral therapeutics in the era of pandemics.
off_label.summary: Researchers are developing broad-acting antiviral drugs to protect against multiple viruses and future pandemics, using both direct viral attacks and host-cell targeting methods.

off_label.title: Old Molecules, New Hope: A Scoping Review and Bibliometric Analysis of Drug Repurposing for Lung Cancer.
off_label.summary: Researchers found that repurposing existing approved drugs like niclosamide and metformin shows promise for treating lung cancer more quickly and affordably.

biomarkers.title: Identification and characterization of a lipopolysaccharide binding, anti-inflammatory protein from Parabacteroides distasonis.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified a gut bacteria protein that binds harmful bacterial toxins and reduces inflammatory responses, suggesting potential therapeutic benefits.

biomarkers.title: Age-related patterns in prostate cancer: epidemiology, pathology, treatment, and survival.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers systematically compared prostate cancer incidence, pathology, treatment, and survival outcomes across different age groups.

biomarkers.title: Molecular mechanisms and therapeutic strategies: DNA methylation in pancreatic cancer.
biomarkers.summary: DNA methylation changes drive pancreatic cancer development and could improve diagnosis and treatment options.

biomarkers.title: Epigenetic silencing L3MBTL4 sensitizes esophageal cancer to DNA-PKcs inhibitor.
biomarkers.summary: Silencing L3MBTL4 protein makes esophageal cancer cells vulnerable to DNA-repair inhibitor drugs.

biomarkers.title: Equine genital and ocular squamous cell carcinomas: clinical, histopathological, molecular and viral characterization with proposed histopathological classification system.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified six types of horse squamous cell carcinoma and found that tumor subtype, not viral infection, predicts patient survival outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Porphyromonas gingivalis secreted factors drive epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) through gingipains and an H2S-mediated bacterial defense system.
biomarkers.summary: Oral bacterium P. gingivalis promotes colorectal cancer progression through secreted proteins and hydrogen sulfide, triggering cell transformation and increased motility.

biomarkers.title: Enhanced magnetic hyperthermia using anti-PD-L1 antibody-conjugated magnetoliposomes in a murine subcutaneous bladder cancer model.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers combined heat therapy with immune-boosting antibodies in magnetized particles to improve bladder cancer treatment in mice.

biomarkers.title: Ginkgolic acid targets HSPA8 to trigger ferroptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma via chaperone-mediated autophagy-dependent GPX4 degradation.
biomarkers.summary: Ginkgolic acid from Ginkgo biloba kills liver cancer cells by triggering a specific type of cell death called ferroptosis.

biomarkers.title: Diffuse pediatric-type high grade glioma, RTK1 subtype, subclass C with SYN2::PPARG fusion in an older adult.
biomarkers.summary: A rare pediatric-type brain tumor with a novel SYN2::PPARG fusion was identified in an older adult, highlighting molecular testing's importance for accurate diagnosis.

biomarkers.title: circOMA1 delivered by exosomes regulates DRD2‑mediated prolactinoma resistance.
biomarkers.summary: CircOMA1, delivered by exosomes, drives cabergoline resistance in prolactin-secreting pituitary tumors by disrupting dopamine receptor signaling.

biomarkers.title: Targeting Mettl8-Tcf1 axis promotes CD8+ TPEX differentiation and antitumor immunity.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking Mettl8 in lung cancer enhances immune cells' anti-tumor function and improves immunotherapy effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: TIE2 links MEKK3-KLF2/4 and PI3K signaling in cerebral cavernous malformation.
biomarkers.summary: TIE2 receptor links two key signaling pathways in cerebral cavernous malformations, and blocking it prevents disease formation in mice.

biomarkers.title: Hypoxia‑induced exosomal CAMTA1 promotes radio‑resistance in MDA‑MB‑231 cells by regulating NRG1 to mediate M2 macrophage polarization.
biomarkers.summary: Breast cancer cells release exosomes containing CAMTA1 protein that promotes radiation resistance by converting immune cells into tumor-supporting M2 macrophages.

biomarkers.title: ZBTB7A promotes malignant phenotypes in ovarian cancer through transcriptional activation of CRLF1.
biomarkers.summary: ZBTB7A protein promotes ovarian cancer growth and spread by activating the CRLF1 gene, suggesting a new therapeutic target.

biomarkers.title: Heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein K in cancer biology and its therapeutic applications (Review).
biomarkers.summary: hnRNPK protein regulates cancer growth and could serve as a biomarker and therapeutic target across multiple cancer types.

trials.title: Age-related patterns in prostate cancer: epidemiology, pathology, treatment, and survival.
trials.summary: Researchers systematically compared prostate cancer incidence, pathology, treatment, and survival outcomes across different age groups.

trials.title: Targeting Mettl8-Tcf1 axis promotes CD8+ TPEX differentiation and antitumor immunity.
trials.summary: Blocking Mettl8 in lung cancer enhances immune cells' anti-tumor function and improves immunotherapy effectiveness.

trials.title: MS4322 is a selective protein arginine methyltransferase 5 degrader with antitumor effects in cervical cancer cells.
trials.summary: MS4322 drug effectively kills cervical cancer cells by blocking a protein called PRMT5 that fuels tumor growth.

trials.title: Efficacy and cost-effectiveness of lung cancer screening in France with low-dose computed tomography.
trials.summary: Low-dose CT lung cancer screening effectively saves lives in France and costs €7,629 per quality-adjusted life year gained.

trials.title: Incidental endometrial cancer diagnosis during pre-IVF workup: fertility-sparing treatment and embryo preservation.
trials.summary: Early-stage endometrial cancer was discovered during fertility workup, allowing fertility-preserving treatment and embryo storage before cancer therapy.

trials.title: Treating microsatellite unstable metastatic parathyroid carcinoma with anti-PD1 therapy.
trials.summary: Pembrolizumab immunotherapy successfully treated metastatic parathyroid carcinoma with microsatellite instability, normalizing hormone levels and shrinking tumors.

trials.title: BRAF Mutation Drives Early Multifocal Intrahepatic Recurrence after Curative Resection of Liver-Limited Colorectal Metastases.
trials.summary: BRAF mutations in colorectal cancer patients predict early, widespread cancer return in the liver after surgery.

trials.title: Prediagnostic primary care consultations and imaging in emergency-diagnosed versus referred patients with lung cancer: a population-based linked data study.
trials.summary: Lung cancer patients diagnosed through emergency care have worse outcomes than those referred through primary care.

trials.title: GP perspectives on genomics in primary care: a qualitative study on using polygenic risk scores to evaluate cancer risk.
trials.summary: Doctors could use genetic risk scores to personalize cancer screening for melanoma, colorectal, breast, and prostate cancers in primary care.

trials.title: Tyrosine phosphoproteome profiling identifies cell-intrinsic signals limiting the efficacy of tyrosine kinase inhibitor therapies.
trials.summary: Combining SFK/ABL inhibitors with standard kinase inhibitors overcomes resistance by blocking compensatory signaling that limits cancer treatment effectiveness.

trials.title: DKK1 expression associates with tertiary lymphoid structure maturity in non-small cell lung cancer.
trials.summary: Researchers identified a prognostic score for lung cancer based on immune structures and found that DKK1 protein impairs their maturation.

trials.title: Incidence and management of pyrexia syndrome in patients treated with dabrafenib and trametinib: a retrospective study.
trials.summary: Fever is a common side effect in patients taking dabrafenib and trametinib for BRAF-mutated cancers and requires careful management.

trials.title: Preclinical efficacy of combination therapy with allogeneic induced pluripotent stem cell-derived invariant natural killer T and α-galactosylceramide-pulsed antigen-presenting cells.
trials.summary: Lab-made immune cells combined with immune-boosting molecules effectively shrink tumors by activating anti-cancer T cells.

trials.title: Precision in Pharmacoeconomics: A Comparative Cost-Utility Analysis of Osimertinib in EGFR-Mutant NSCLC Using Traditional and Pharmacometric Models.
trials.summary: Pharmacometric modeling of osimertinib in EGFR-mutant lung cancer provides more accurate cost-effectiveness estimates than traditional methods.

trials.title: Synthetic M13 phage engagers expand CAR-T cell antigen recognition to overcome tumor heterogeneity.
trials.summary: Engineered phage-based engagers enable CAR-T cells to target multiple antigens simultaneously, improving glioblastoma treatment by overcoming tumor diversity.

mind_body.title: A Randomized Controlled Trial Examining the Effect of a Web-Based Filial Therapy Program on Parental Role Perception Among Parents of Children With Cancer
mind_body.summary: A web-based filial therapy program helped parents of children with cancer better perceive their parenting role through structured play training.

mind_body.title: A Multicomponent Support Program to Enhance Quality of Life in Chinese Cancer Patients and Survivors (MSP-CCS): Pilot Optimization Trial and Implementation Outcomes
mind_body.summary: A support program combining education, counseling, and peer support improves quality of life for Chinese cancer patients and survivors.

mind_body.title: 'Being empathetic to my patients and ourselves': a qualitative process evaluation of READ-Y psychological first aid training for healthcare workers working in routine care.
mind_body.summary: Healthcare worker training in psychological first aid improves empathy and communication while supporting staff well-being in routine hospital care.

mind_body.title: Music as Supportive Care for Young Children with Sickle Cell Disease and their Parents: A Three-phase Qualitative Exploration into the Cultural Relevance of Active Music Engagement with Black Families.
mind_body.summary: Music therapy sessions involving parents and children show promise in reducing distress for Black families managing sickle cell disease.

mind_body.title: Evaluation of Spiritual Care among Oncologists and Nurses at the Oncology Departments, Marrakech, Morocco.
mind_body.summary: Moroccan nurses report significantly higher awareness of spiritual care for cancer patients than oncologists, suggesting targeted training is needed.

mind_body.title: Hope, strength, and survival: exploring positive psychology interventions in breast cancer care.
mind_body.summary: Positive psychology interventions like gratitude and mindfulness boost hope and resilience in breast cancer patients beyond traditional symptom-focused care.

mind_body.title: Effects of warm needle acupuncture on behavioral pain threshold in a rat model of migraine.
mind_body.summary: Warm needle acupuncture effectively increases pain tolerance in migraine-affected rats, suggesting benefits for migraine treatment.

mind_body.title: FearLess in Neuro-Oncology: Phase I trial targeting fear of cancer recurrence in patients with primary malignant glioma and their caregivers.
mind_body.summary: A new therapy called FearLess helps glioma patients and caregivers reduce anxiety about cancer recurrence.

mind_body.title: Symptom distress and treatment interest for cognitive decline in neuro-oncology.
mind_body.summary: Brain tumor patients experience cognitive decline that causes distress, and researchers are identifying treatment preferences to develop better support programs.

mind_body.title: Cancer in Poetry-Poetry in Cancer: A Linguistic Analysis of Poems by Poets on Their Own Cancer and on the Cancer of Their Loved Ones.
mind_body.summary: Analyzing cancer poems reveals how poets use writing to process their own cancer diagnosis and support loved ones facing the disease.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of Non-pharmacological interventions on pain and fatigue management in cancer survivors: A systematic review and meta-analysis study.
mind_body.summary: Acupuncture and reflexology effectively reduce pain in cancer survivors, while physical activity shows minimal benefit for pain or fatigue.

mind_body.title: Effectiveness of Pilates in cancer patients for pain and functionality measures: A systematic review.
mind_body.summary: Pilates exercises reduce pain and improve physical function in cancer patients compared to standard treatments.

mind_body.title: Spirituality and Quality of Life of Informal Caregivers of Cancer Patients: A Systematic Review.
mind_body.summary: Spirituality helps improve the quality of life and mental health of people caring for cancer patients, suggesting it's a valuable coping strategy.

mind_body.title: Mindfulness vs. sleep education during autologous hematopoietic cell transplantation for multiple myeloma: Feasibility of a randomized controlled pilot study.
mind_body.summary: A study tested whether mindfulness training or sleep education helps multiple myeloma patients sleep better during stem cell transplantation.

mind_body.title: Analgesic effects of electroacupuncture via the EphBs-p38 MAPK signaling pathway and microglial suppression in the chronic constriction injury rat model of neuropathic pain.
mind_body.summary: Electroacupuncture reduces nerve pain in rats by suppressing brain immune cells and blocking specific pain signaling pathways.
